title: Backend Engineer (Java)
text: Build microservices with Java, Spring Boot, Kafka and PostgreSQL. Deploy on AWS with Docker and Kubernetes. REST APIs, CI/CD, Redis caching.

title: Frontend Engineer (React)
text: Develop user interfaces in React, TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML and CSS. Work with designers on UX, accessibility, and A/B testing.

title: Machine Learning Engineer
text: Train and deploy machine learning models with Python, scikit-learn, PyTorch and pandas. NLP, feature engineering, model evaluation, MLOps.

title: DevOps Engineer
text: Own CI/CD pipelines with Jenkins and GitHub Actions. Infrastructure as code with Terraform. Kubernetes, Docker, AWS, monitoring and on-call.

title: Data Engineer
text: Build data pipelines with Python, SQL, Spark and Airflow. Data warehousing on Snowflake and BigQuery. Kafka streaming and ETL.

title: Android Developer
text: Build Android apps in Kotlin and Java with Jetpack Compose, REST integrations, offline storage, and Play Store releases.
